01 · Overview

What makes this a Super App

A typical Uber-style app offers one service: rides. This platform is a Super App — one login, one wallet, one maps engine — where new service categories plug into the same foundation instead of requiring a rebuild every time.

📱

Customer App

Android & iOS — end users book any service from one screen

🧰

Provider App

Android & iOS — drivers, chefs, mechanics, riders & workers

🖥️

Admin Panel

Browser dashboard to run and monitor the whole platform

🌐

Website

Optional marketing / landing page for the brand

02 · Service Categories

Six mini-marketplaces, one platform

Each module works independently but shares the same login, wallet, and map engine — keeping future expansion far cheaper than launching a separate app for every new idea.

🚗

Ride Hailing

Car, bike, or rickshaw rides with live driver tracking.

🍔

Food Delivery

Order from restaurants with live delivery tracking.

👨‍🍳

Chef Booking

Hire a professional chef for home cooking, events, or parties.

🔧

Mechanic / Auto Repair

On-demand vehicle repair, tyre change & roadside assistance.

🏠

Home Services

Electrician, plumber, cleaner, painter, and handyman work.

📦

Courier / Parcel

Send packages point-to-point using a nearby rider.

Built to grow: new service categories can be added later using the same login, wallet, and maps engine — no rebuild required, ever.
03 · Core Features

The foundation, included in every service

These features are required no matter which service module is being used — they ship with the base plan, for every module, at no extra cost.

Account & Access

  • Phone, email, or social login
  • OTP verification (SMS)
  • Secure login / logout & sessions
  • Account recovery
  • Profile management

Maps & Location

  • Live GPS pickup / drop-off
  • Real-time provider tracking
  • Route, distance & ETA
  • Saved favorite addresses

Booking Flow

  • Service selection screen
  • Instant or scheduled booking
  • Confirmation & status tracking
  • Order history with receipts

Payments

  • Card, wallet, cash, or bank
  • In-app wallet, add / withdraw
  • Automatic fare calculation
  • Refunds & cancellations
  • Multi-currency support

Communication

  • In-app chat
  • Masked in-app voice calls
  • Push notifications

Trust & Safety

  • Ratings & reviews
  • SOS button with live location
  • Provider document verification
  • Report / complaint system

Multi-Language

  • English, French, Urdu, Spanish, Arabic
  • Switchable anytime in settings
  • More languages addable later

Admin Panel

  • Manage users & providers
  • Earnings & commission reports
  • Document approvals
  • Pricing & promo codes
04 · Optional Add-ons

Not required to launch — added on request

The app works completely fine without any of these. Each one adds extra development time, so it only gets built if the client actually wants it.

AI Chatbot Support
Automated first-response customer support inside the app
Medium impact
Loyalty / Rewards
Points or cashback for customers who keep coming back
Medium impact
Subscription Plans
Monthly plans, e.g. a "free delivery" membership
Medium impact
Referral System
Rewards for both sides when a customer invites a friend
Low impact
In-app Video Call
Face-to-face video between customer and provider
High impact
Advanced Analytics
Deeper business graphs, forecasts & heatmaps for the admin
Medium impact
Multi-Vendor Marketplace
Independent shops manage their own listings and stock
High impact
Split Payment
Multiple people pay for one order together
Medium impact
In-app Advertising
Paid banners/ads from partner businesses inside the app
Low impact
Offline Mode
Basic app usage still works with a weak or no connection
High impact
05 · Technology Stack

Chosen for speed, reliability, and lower long-term cost

One codebase covers both Android and iOS — instead of building and maintaining two separate native apps.

Customer & Provider App
Flutter
One codebase for Android & iOS — faster, cheaper, consistent design
Backend Server
Node.js (NestJS)
Fast, scalable, suited to real-time features like live tracking
Database
PostgreSQL + Redis
Reliable transactions; Redis keeps live driver data fast
Admin Panel
React.js
Fast, modern, easy-to-maintain dashboard
Maps & Location
Google Maps Platform
Most accurate global maps, routing & ETA data
Push Notifications
Firebase Cloud Messaging
Free, reliable across Android & iOS
Payments
Stripe / PayPal + local gateways
Trusted internationally, multi-currency support
Cloud Hosting
AWS or DigitalOcean
Scales automatically as the user base grows
Real-time Tracking
WebSockets / Socket.io
Live driver & provider location updates on the map

07 · Cost Breakdown

Infrastructure & third-party costs

The development fee is handled separately, as agreed. This section covers only what it costs to actually run the platform — the accounts, tools, and services the app depends on.

One-Time / Setup Costs

Apple Developer Account
Required to publish on the App Store
$99 / year
Google Play Console
Required to publish on the Play Store
$25 one-time
Domain Name
Website / admin panel address
$10–15 / year
SSL Certificate
Secures all app-to-server data
Free – $100 / yr
UI/UX Design Assets
Icons, illustrations, brand elements
$100–500 one-time

Recurring / Monthly Costs

Cloud Server Hosting
Runs the backend & database
$50–300 / mo
Google Maps API
Maps, routing, ETA, and address search
Pay-as-you-go
SMS / OTP (Twilio)
Verification codes on sign-up & login
~$0.01–0.05 / SMS
Push Notifications
Order & booking alerts
Free (normal usage)
Cloud Storage
Photos, documents, uploaded files
$5–50 / mo
Payment Gateway Fees
Charged per successful transaction
~2.9% + $0.30
Email Service
Receipts & account alerts
Free tier, then ~$15/mo
Maps and payment gateway costs scale with usage — more bookings mean more map requests and transactions, so the exact monthly cost depends on how many active users the platform has.

What changes the cost

No extra cost

Every Core Feature (Section 03) — login, maps, payments, bookings, chat, notifications, admin panel, multi-language — already in the base plan.

Extra, only if included

Any Optional Add-on (Section 04) — AI chatbot, video call, subscriptions, multi-vendor marketplace, split payment, and so on.

Scales with usage

Maps API requests, SMS/OTP messages, payment gateway fees, and cloud storage — grow with customer activity, not with features.

08 · Security & Scalability

Built to protect data and grow with demand

These protections are built in from day one, not added later as an afterthought.

Encrypted data

All passwords and sensitive data are encrypted, both in transit and at rest.

PCI-compliant payments

The app never stores raw card numbers directly on its own servers.

Scales by design

More servers can be added as users grow, across more cities and countries.

Regular backups

Database backups run on a schedule to prevent any data loss.
